rationale: Independent sampling of HEAD eb34b6e9… shows a coherent ContinuityOps lab: validators and local tests green, Terraform/Helm/worker artifacts real, digest and worker.zip pins consistent, alerts/SLO/agentic negative tests usable, and claims/restore evidence labeled synthetic without inventing live apply. Residual gaps are authority metadata drift (plan-approval/accuracy-final vs STATUS remediation), evidence SHA lag behind HEAD, and repo-only/synthetic honesty for observability and resilience — disclosed, appropriate for this lab scaffold, and not a qualitative reason to withhold merge of the ContinuityOps folder.
